listingTitle: Avoid unshifting JavaScript arrays in loops
title: Avoid unshifting JavaScript arrays in loops
why: Array.unshift moves existing elements, so repeatedly inserting at the front of an array can produce quadratic work.
suggestion: Append and reverse once when order permits, advance through a different representation, or use a deque implementation for front-insertion semantics.
limitations: Only variables with an array type annotation or array-literal assignment unshifted inside braced loops are reported.
Aliases, reassignment, collection size, and bounded loop counts are not inferred.
